rows.scenario: Dashboard overview shows the current gateway status after sync
steps: Run the hardware-sync gate for the iot-dashboard profile.
Inspect the primary system status card.
rows.expectedUi: The dashboard shows a visible system-status card with the text Online and a current sync indicator.
rows.expectedHardware: The gateway and bridge report a synchronized runtime state before UI verification starts.
rows.preconditions: A CDP-accessible browser already has the application reachable at the dashboard route.
rows.passFailSignal: Pass when the system status card is visible and contains Online; fail otherwise.
rows.uiTargetHints: Use the existing dashboard tab if one is already open.
rows.actionIntent: Verify the overview can still expose a stable, inspectable status card after sync.
rows.uiActionNotes: Capture a screenshot after the assertion.

rows.scenario: Alerts panel shows a sensor-offline banner when the bridge reports a disconnect
steps: Run the hardware-sync gate for the iot-dashboard profile.
Verify that the offline banner appears for the affected sensor within the timing budget.
rows.expectedUi: The alerts panel displays an offline banner for Kitchen Temperature within 30 seconds of the bridge disconnect event.
rows.expectedHardware: The bridge reports the sensor-offline condition and the synchronized runtime state remains valid for the pass.
rows.preconditions: The dashboard route is reachable and the row has access to a simulated or known sensor-offline condition.
rows.passFailSignal: Pass when the offline banner appears within 30 seconds; fail when the panel remains in a healthy state or shows stale data.
rows.uiTargetHints: Reuse the dashboard tab and switch to the alerts panel before checking the banner.
rows.actionIntent: Prove the alerts UI and the underlying bridge condition stay correlated within the expected timing window.
rows.uiActionNotes: If the banner does not appear, capture a screenshot and emit a defect artifact.

rows.scenario: Sensor reconnection clears the offline banner after a rig-triggered recovery path
steps: Verify that the offline banner clears within the timing budget.
rows.expectedUi: The alerts panel clears the offline banner within 20 seconds of a successful recovery action.
rows.expectedHardware: The rig exposes a remote recovery path and the bridge reports the recovered state.
rows.preconditions: A remotely invokable recovery path exists for the example rig or simulator.
rows.passFailSignal: Pass when the banner clears in time; rig-blocked if the recovery path is unavailable; product-defect if the banner remains stale after a valid recovery.
rows.uiTargetHints: Stay on the alerts panel after inducing the disconnect state.
rows.actionIntent: Keep rig limitations visible instead of deleting hard rows from the matrix.
rows.uiActionNotes: If the rig cannot trigger recovery remotely, mark the row rig-blocked and preserve the row in the checkpoint discussion.
evidenceExpectations: Proof that the recovery path was or was not remotely available
